oneLine: OfBusiness is heading for an IPO, creating future liquidity for its founders.

sources.title: Decoding The Commerce And Lending Engines Of IPO-Bound OfBusiness

synopsis: OfBusiness is heading for the stock market with an upcoming IPO that creates future liquidity for its founders. The company operates a commerce business spanning raw-material trading, manufacturing, and apparel that generates almost all its sales, alongside a lending business led by Oxyzo that contributes more than half of its segment profits. In FY26, OfBusiness reported consolidated operating revenue of ₹20,472 Cr, down nearly 8% year on year, while net profit climbed 21% to ₹724 Cr. The lending-led financial services generated ₹505 Cr in profit before tax compared with ₹422 Cr from commerce. The company achieved unicorn status alongside its lending arm Oxyzo, while preparing for its stock market debut.
